amendments.matter_rule_prior_text: Every matter species is minimally coupled to the same metric g_mu_nu and to no candidate gravitational field.
amendments.rationale: Version 1.0 forbade every direct scalar-matter coupling, which is the clause that blocks each surviving screened-gravity lift (recorded as residual blocker 'missing_adapter:direct_scalar_matter_coupling' on all twelve STABLE_PASS families in runs/gpu-baryonic-screen/nonlocal-localization-v1.json). That single prohibition conflates two different things. Hidden mass is unfalsifiable bookkeeping: a per-object free mass parameter or an unseen component can absorb any residual, so it is forbidden absolutely and remains so. A declared scalar field carrying a declared coupling that is universal -- one and the same function for every matter species and every object, with no per-object freedom -- is not hidden mass. It is a modification of gravity, it preserves the weak equivalence principle because every species still falls along geodesics of one common metric, and it is falsifiable: the same coupling that fits a galaxy also fixes the Solar-System and cluster predictions, so it can be killed by measurement. Version 1.1 therefore distinguishes the two and permits only the second, under declaration.
amendments.not_weakened: The absolute prohibitions of clause (a) are unchanged and are now stated explicitly and separately, so a per-object mass parameter still fails the contract; the lensing-only-coupling, on-shell-substitution, and species-selected-dependence prohibitions are carried over verbatim.

action_contract.matter_rule: Every matter species is minimally coupled to one and the same coupling metric g~_mu_nu, and to no candidate gravitational field beyond that one metric. By default g~_mu_nu = g_mu_nu. A candidate may instead declare g~_mu_nu = A^2(phi) g_mu_nu with a single declared coupling function A shared by every species and every object; that declaration is governed by coupling_policy and by nothing else.
action_contract.stress_tensor: T_m^{mu nu} = (2/sqrt(-g)) delta S_m/delta g_{mu nu}
action_contract.on_shell_identity: nabla_mu T_m^{mu nu} = 0 when the matter equations hold

absolutely_forbidden.rule: No invisible or unseen mass component, and no per-object free mass parameter, may appear anywhere in the action, the solution, or the fit. A candidate that needs one is rejected, never rescued.
instances: a dark halo, of any profile, fitted per object
any mass, density, or mass-to-light quantity that is free to differ between objects
any unseen component introduced to absorb a residual
any per-object metric, per-object coupling, or per-object screening scale
absolutely_forbidden.test: if removing every parameter that is not shared identically by all objects changes the prediction for any object, the candidate violates clause (a)

permitted_with_declaration.rule: A declared gravitational-sector scalar phi may carry a declared matter coupling, provided the coupling is universal: one declared function A(phi), identical for every matter species and every object, entering only through the single coupling metric g~_mu_nu = A^2(phi) g_mu_nu of matter_rule.
permitted_with_declaration.why_this_is_not_hidden_mass: The coupling adds no mass and no per-object freedom. It modifies how one common metric responds to the baryons that are already counted, every species still follows geodesics of g~_mu_nu so the weak equivalence principle is preserved, and the one universal coupling that shapes a galaxy simultaneously fixes the Solar-System and cluster predictions. It is therefore a falsifiable modification of gravity rather than unfalsifiable bookkeeping.
declaration_requirements: A(phi) is written explicitly in the action
the same A(phi) is used for every species and every object
the coupling strength is a universal constant, never fitted per object
the Solar-System and weak-field limits are reported under the same declaration
does_not_permit: a coupling that depends on which matter species it acts on
a coupling whose strength or scale varies between objects
a coupling introduced only in the lensing sector

coupling_policy.precedence: clause (a) overrides clause (b) whenever they conflict

forbidden: direct dependence of S_grav on a selected matter species, J_b^mu, rho_b, or T_b^{mu nu}
using an on-shell field equation to replace matter by curvature inside the action
